title: feat: limit API keys to specific models
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: API keys can now be limited to specific model IDs alongside existing categories. `image` still permits every image model, but `flux` now permits only Flux, stored as `black-forest-labs/flux.1-schnell`, instead of widening to all image models. BYOP authorize links can use `models=flux,zimage` to create keys limited to those models. Gen checks canonical model IDs and aliases, so an old ID retained as an alias continues to work after a rename; a community model ID without an alias stops working for a pinned key if ownership transfer changes its ID. The dashboard shows model IDs as removable chips beside category buttons without widening them on save, and links to the polli CLI and API docs. CLI 0.1.43 adds `polli keys update <id> --models …`. Permission refusals now name the key’s limits, such as `text, flux`.

A retro terminal glows beside her against a prominent soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with chunky sprites and an emotionally warm feel.
